summary: Comprehensive testing of Taxi WebToApp MVP completed. Backend APIs working excellently (17/18 tests passed), frontend UI flows functional with modern green theme. All major features tested: role selection, customer/driver auth, admin panel, order management.

minor_bugs.issue: Driver verification returns 'Invalid code' instead of 'AWAITING_ACTIVATION' in specific timing scenario
minor_bugs.impact: Minor - doesn't affect core functionality, likely timing issue

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connections failing to establish for real-time features
integration_issues.symptoms: Console errors: 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'
integration_issues.impact: Real-time notifications may not work, but core functionality unaffected

integration_issues.issue: Timeout when navigating back to role selection after customer login
integration_issues.workaround: Direct navigation to driver auth page works fine

passed_tests: Role selection page loads with Customer and Driver options
Customer auth flow: phone input, SMS code verification (code 1234)
Admin login with credentials admin@taxi.local / admin123
Admin panel navigation and dashboard stats (2 customers, 2 drivers, 1 order)
